name: kata
title_zh: 一次只切一条能跑通的竖片，切完就验
tagline_zh: 设计已经想明白了，代码却一写就散：它逼你把功能切成能独立跑通的小竖片，每片都有明确的完成标准和真跑过的验证记录。
tagline_en: Design is settled but the code sprawls. It forces each feature into a small slice that runs end to end, with.
desc_en: Implement software through small, repeatable, integrated vertical slices with clear exit criteria and honest verification. Use when a design is understood and code needs to be built or changed.
why_zh: 它把「做完」定义成可执行的退出条件，而不是感觉差不多了。每片必须集成、必须验证，验证结果要如实汇报。
why_en: Done means an executable exit criterion, not a vibe. Every slice must be integrated and verified, and the result reported.
limit_zh: 只适合设计已定、进入编码阶段的活；需求还在飘、架构没定的时候它会一直卡在切不出竖片上。它不替你写测试框架。
limit_en: Only for coding once the design is settled; with shifting requirements it stalls trying to cut a slice. It won't set up your test framework, deploy.
title_en: One runnable vertical slice at a time, verified before the.
